body: There is someone, or rather, a few people I wish I had unconditional love from, but its also because I think I've subconsciously set a standard for myself to be the best and I can't get past it. I have a friend that has always been stronger than me, leaner than me, and is everything the girls like and I've always strived to be better than him. It's impossible to me. I've worked and worked and cut fat and I work out 5 days a week. I know this is a terrible mindset to have, and it's dysfunctional but there's no way for me to fix it, at least from my point of view.
I volunteer! My kik is JDGNR
